claim.basis: Issuer-reported point-in-time Form 10-Q amounts used to qualify demand visibility, balance-sheet strength and risk.

evidence.applicability_limit: Supports the reported point-in-time amounts only; it does not prove future backlog conversion, margin, free cash flow, or current balances after 2026-06-30.
evidence.excerpt: Q2 Form 10-Q remains latest operating filing; it reports USD 289 billion backlog, USD 8.305 billion cash and USD 37.383 billion debt.
evidence.locator: RTX Q2 2026 Form 10-Q, backlog and consolidated balance-sheet disclosures
evidence.rationale: The inspected Form 10-Q directly supplies the dated backlog, cash and debt observations used in the assessment.

claim.proposition: RTX reported USD 289 billion of backlog, USD 8.305 billion of cash and USD 37.383 billion of debt at the Q2 2026 reporting date.
claim.scope: RTX Corporation consolidated backlog, cash and total debt at 2026-06-30
claim.uncertainty: Backlog timing and profitability are not guaranteed; cash and debt are point-in-time balances and do not by themselves establish cash conversion or net leverage.
